Title: Create and Edit Zipper
Content: List of Contents Create Edit (7.3) Objective Create and Edit Zippers quickly and easily. Location Main Menu Materials Zipper Zipper or Edit Zipper 3D Toolbar Zipper or Edit Zipper Operation Create Click the tool /menu in Location. Click on the 3D garment or 2D Patterns (ver 5.2) where the Zipper is attached, then move the cursor. Based on the direction the cursor was moved, the segment where the Zipper appears is highlighted in light blue. Double click on the desired endpoint for the Zipper. One side of the Zipper is created. Click on the Pattern outline where the other side of the Zipper is attached, then move the cursor. Based on the direction the cursor was moved, a blue point appears indicating the same length as the first half of the Zipper that was created. Double click on the blue point. The Zipper is now complete along with a Puller, a Slider, and a Stopper Activate the The Zipper simulates being closed. Edit (ver 7.3) Click the tool /menu in Location. Click the end point of the zipper Drag in direction to be edited, then Click on the end point of the opposite zipper Drag it the same way. A blue dot is displayed at the same point as the opposite length. Drag to the blue dot. Both lengths of the zipper are modified. Note: Cancel Actions during Zipper Creation Cancel All Actions While using the Zipper tool, press Esc or Ctlr +Z on the keyboard and all actions will be undone. Cancel Last Action While using the Zipper tool, press Delete or Backspace on the keyboard and the last action will be undone.

Title: Line (3D Pattern)
Content: List of Contents Line (3D Pattern) Create Line (3D Pattern) Line (3D Pattern) - Draw lines on draped 3D Garment in the 3D Window. - Select the Line (3D Pattern) tool from the 3D toolbar. Create Line(3D Pattern) - Select the Line (3D Pattern) tool from the 3D toolbar. - Click on 3D Garment where the start point of the line should be created. - Move the mouse as a yellow point follows along and a black segment connecting two points is created. - Click as needed to create desired shape of line. - Hold down the Ctrl key on the keyboard to create the curve. - Double click the end point or click the start point again to create a line or a shape, respectively. - As the line or the shape is completed, it will be highlighted in yellow. - The created line or shape will appear on 3D Garment and on 2D Pattern as baseline.

Title: Edit Line (Avatar)
Content: List of Contents Edit Line (Avatar) Use Line (Avatar) Edit Line (Avatar) - Edit the shapes and lines drawn with the Line (Avatar) tool. - Select the Edit Line (Avatar) tool from the 3D toolbar. - Or, navigate to Main Menu and select 3D Garment Edit Line (Avatar). Add Point - Edit by adding a Segment Point to Line (Avatar) using the right-click pop-up menu. - Select the Line(Avatar) tool from the 3D toolbar. - Right click on the Line(Avatar) where a Segment Point should be added. - Then, Select Add Point. Add Curve Point - Edit by adding a Curve Point ti Line (Avatar) using the right-click pop-up menu. - Select the Line(Avatar) tool from the 3D toolbar. - Right click on the Line(Avatar) where a Curve Point should be added. - Then, Select Add Point. Flattening as Straight Line(ver4.1.0) - Flatten selected lines straight by using the right-click pop-up menu. - Select the Line(Avatar) tool from the 3D toolbar. - Right click on the Line(Avatar) to be flattened as a straight line and select Flattening as Straight Line. Use Line (Avatar) Select Point/Line - After selecting the Edit Line (Avatar) tool, hover over the line on the Avatar or the object in the 3D window. Click when the line is highlighted in light blue. - When the line is properly selected, the line will be highlighted in yellow. - Similarly, when the mouse is hovered over a point, only the point will be highlighted in light blue. Click once to select. - The point will be highlighted in yellow. Edit Line/Shape - Edit lines by moving the points on the lines. - Click and drag the point as the point moves along the mouse cursor. Delete - Delete the selected points and lines. - Right click on the point to be deleted to access the pop-up menu. - Select the Delete option. - To delete a whole line or a shape, right click on the line or shape to access the pop-up menu. - Select the Delete option. The selected line or the shape will be deleted. - Or, when the desired item is selected, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to delete the selected item.

Title: Alvanon Avatar (AVAC) Open
Content: Objective Load purchased certified Alvanon Avatar into CLO. Note: To successfully load an Alvanon Avatar, it must go through a certification process. Loading an avatar without certification will restrict simulation and file saving. Location Main Menu File Open Avatar (Ctrl+Shift+A) Operation Click the tool/menu in Location The Open File window will appear. Select the Alvanon Avatar file to be loaded and select OK. Alvanon authentication window will appear. Complete the certification process by entering of Alvanon Body platform ID/FW If certified successfully, the avatar will be loaded.

Title: Compatible with Wacom 3D Pen (ver 6.0)
Content: Wacom 3D Pen Settings How to Control View in CLO Recommended Pen and Touch Settings for windows Objective Control the view of the screen with the Wacom Pro Pen (2D) and 3D Pen without any key combination. Location Main Menu Settings User Settings View Control Wacom Pen Operation Wacom 3D Pen Settings Click the Start button. Type Wacom Tablet Properties and click on the first search result. My devices Click the tablet connected Click the Pen settings. In the Wacom Tablet Properties Window click on the Pen in the tool list. Click on the plus "+" button to add an application profile. Click on the Browse button in the new window to locate CLO executable and click OK button. Set the pen button settings according to the recommended configuration for each of them. Wacom Pro Pen 2 Wacom Pro Pen 3D How to Set Space Bar: Click the dropdown menu Keyboard Modifier Keys Check on 'Space Bar' How to Control View in CLO Control the view in the following way. Move Hold down the middle button while hovering, move the pen on the tablet. Zoom Hold down the middle button while the pen tip is touching the device and move the pen in the vertical direction. Rotate Hold down the bottom button while the pen tip is touching or placing close to the device, move the pen to rotate. Simulate (Pro Pen 3D Only) Press the top button once to turn on the simulation and press once again to turn it off. Select Mesh (Brush) (Ver 6.1) When using the Select Mesh (brush) tool, resize the area where the mesh is selected based on the pressure of the pen on the tablet screen. Note: Use another key (e.g. Alt) on the keyboard with the pen to control the view in the 5.2 or lower versions. Recommended pen and Touch Settings for Windows. Click the Start button. Type Control Panel and click on the first search result. Switch the Control Panel display mode to a small icon. Click on Pen and Touch settings. Double-tab Double-click (Default Value) Press and hold Select the row Click Settings Check off Enable press and hold for right-clicking. Pen Buttons Check on both menus below. Use the pen button as a right-click equivalent. Use the top of the pen to erase ink (where available).

Title: Ruler & Guidelines
Content: List of Contents Show/Hide Ruler and Setting Create and Move Guideline Set Guideline Options Objective Place 2D elements or create pattern using Ruler and Guidelines in 2D Window. Or right click on a segment to be a reference of a guideline or two points and click Create a Guideline Along Points. A guideline is created based on the selected points or the segment. Note: Click Ruler Hit the Ctrl key on the keyboard when click-and-dragging the guideline or hold the Ctrl key and click the guideline to convert its direction. Title: Wind Controller Setting
Content: List of Contents Properties Direction and Range Settings Add and Duplicate Objective Adjust and apply wind effect to create fluttering effect on garment in the 3D window. Location Main Menu Display Environment Show Wind Controller 3D Window Environment Display Icon Show Wind Controller Operation Properties Select the tool indicated in Location. The Wind Controller appears in the 3D window. Click the Wind Controller. Wind Controller Gizmo activates. Wind Controller properties appear in the Property Editor. Adjust the default values at Property Editor according to the needs. Option Description Name Set the name of the Wind Controller. Activate Set the activation status of the wind. Unlimited Bound (ver 2024.0) Set the range of influence of the wind. By default, the wind effect is applied to the entire 3D window, and if you turn this option off, you can directly adjust the range of wind influence with the gizmo and apply it only to the set area. Type Set the type of the wind. Spherical The wind blows in spherical shape, in every direction starting from the Wind Controller. Planar The wind blows only from the designated direction, regardless of the Wind Controller's location. Strength Set the intensity of the wind. The higher the value, the stronger the wind. Decay [0~100] Set the range of the wind. The wind draws an arc and blows weaker according to the set value of wind intensity. If the value is "0", it blows in a straight line endlessly. Frequency (sec) Set the cycle of the wind. The wind repeatably blows weaker and stronger in interval of set value of seconds. If the value is "0", it blows regularly. Turbulence (Turbulence) Set the turbulence of wind intensity. The higher the value, the more irregular the wind intensity. Translate Adjust the location of the Wind Controller by entering X, Y, and Z axis values. Direction and Range Settings Click the Wind Controller and use the gizmo to adjust the wind location. Click the scale icon at the top right of the gizmo. It is switched to a scale gizmo that allows you to adjust the area of influence of the wind. Note: The wind area can only be adjusted when the "Unlimited Bound" option in the Wind Property Editor is turned off. Use the gizmo to control the area of influence of the wind. The adjusted area is displayed immediately. Click the Simulation. The Wind Effect is now being activated as adjusted in the 3D window. Create and Duplicate Click the Object Browser Scene tab Environment Wind. A list of Wind Controllers is displayed. On the top-level item in the wind, right-click Create Wind Controller menu. A new Wind Controller is created. Otherwise, right-click on an already-added wind item and click the Duplicate menu. It is duplicated as a Wind Controller with the same properties as the selected wind. Note: You can also duplicate by right-clicking on the wind controller in the 3D window.

Content: Objective Change the default settings of the software menu according to user preference in User Settings. Upon restarting, the user settings of the software becomes the default settings. Shortcut keys, menus, graphic options, view controls, and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. Location Main Menu Settings User Settings View Control Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Settings User Settings View Control Note: A key and mouse control combination can be set for one function. If a combination is repeated, the interface may not work properly. Preset Select one of the default presets. Pan Select a key and mouse combination for moving the screen. Zoom Select a key and mouse combination for zooming in or out the screen. Rotate (3D Window) Select a key and mouse combination for rotating the screen. Popup Menu Select a key and mouse combination for opening the pop-up menu of the 3D Window. Others Axis Constraint Key Select the key that is used to move items across a constrained horizontal axis, vertical axis, or 45º angle. Smart Panning Toggle on/off the option to Pan automatically based on the location of the mouse cursor while using certain functions. (Ver .2.5.0) Auto Focus (ver5.0.0) Toggle on to automatically change the 3D window's focus point based on the user's click. Switch back focus to the default when unselected: The 3D window's focus point returns to all objects when an object is not selected. This option only appears when the Auto Focus is toggled ON. View Point Default Y-Axis Position Set the default position of the Y-Axis. Default X-Axis Position Set the default position of the X-Axis. Default Camera Distance for Viewpoint Shortcuts (ver4.2.0) Set the distance between the object and the camera when using the shortcut for view control. Change this setting when the default distance is too far away from the small object. Note: Right-Clicks on a MAC By default, right-clicks are disabled on Macs (Magic Mice, as well as others.) However, the right-click gives you access to important pop-up menus in CLO. You can easily enable right-clicks for your Mac mouse by following the instructions below: Navigate to System Preferences (either from your dock or from the Apple menu on the top left hand corner of the screen.) Select Mouse. The Secondary Click (Click on right side) option will be unchecked. Check it to enable right-clicks.

Title: Set Graphic Options
Content: Objective Set CLO's Graphic Options Location Main Menu Setting User Settings Graphic Options Operation Select the too/menu indicated in Location. Antialiasing Set how smooth the outlines of objects appear. As the number increases, the outlines become smoother and the rendering speed becomes slower Use VBOs Set the VBOs usage in order to improve the rendering speed. Normal Blending (ver 6.1) Choose how to blend the normal map. The normal map blending result is reflected in the 3D window and UV Editor. Alpha Blending A method that simulates the normal blending effect using the alpha value. Partial Derivative A method of blending the height map using partial derivatives of the normal map. Whiteout A technique optimized to reduce the amount of computation and it is a way to preserve detail while maintaining the tendency of a relatively flat normal. UDN Compared to Whiteout and Reoriented, the detail of the normal map is slightly reduced but the optimized calculation method is useful for low-end platforms. Reoriented A method that preserves the intensity of all mixed normal maps while maintaining the trend of the flat normal map and the details of the complex normal map well. This is the most accurate and slow method by rotating the normal of the detail to match the normal of the base. Unity It is the same method as reoriented but the error in certain situations (when two mixed normals are orthogonal) is abandoned and the performance is improved.

Title: Gizmo Axis Setting
Content: Objective There are three different Gizmo types in CLO. Select and utilize it as needed. Location Main Menu Preferences Gizmo 3D Window Right-click (on the 3D window) Gizmo Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Preferences Gizmo 3D Window Right-click (on the 3D window) Gizmo Select a desired Gizmo. Select an object with Select/Move Tool. The chosen type of Gizmo appears. Click the axis of the Gizmo Drag it to the desired location. The chosen object moves along with the Gizmo. Screen Coordinate Gizmo Screen Coordinate Gizmo is based on the camera axis. Change the camera view in order to change the gizmo axis. Selected object moves along with the camera axis. Local Coordinate Gizmo Local Coordinate Gizmo axis is based on following the native direction of an object. Mainly usable when designing poses from the avatar's X-ray joint points. Selected object moves to native direction of an object. World Coordinate Gizmo World Coordinate Gizmo is based on 3D space regardless of screens or objects. Selected object moves based on 3D space regardless of screens or objects.
